assessment.summary: Ready with minor improvements — The small Result abstraction narrows cleanly and preserves failure identity; a generic error parameter would make the public contract more reusable.

positives.summary: The discriminant supports direct narrowing without assertions or optional fields.

evidence.snippet:
export type Result<T> =
  | { ok: true; value: T }

findings.title: Fixed Result error type
findings.summary: Result is generic over its success value but permanently fixes failures to Error.
findings.whyItMatters: A reusable generic abstraction should parameterize the dimensions callers need to preserve. Callers with structured domain failures must erase them or create a parallel Result type.
findings.impact: Callers with structured domain failures must erase them or create a parallel Result type.

evidence.message: The exported Result type parameterizes only the success value.
evidence.snippet:
export type Result<T> =
  | { ok: true; value: T }

findings.recommendation: Consider Result<T, E = Error> if this abstraction is intended to cross package boundaries. The current form is simpler and is reasonable if Error is an intentional package-wide policy.

opinion.summary: I would merge this change as-is.
